concerns.text: Tasks T000, T006, T008, and T008b are marked as 'Re-executed' or 'Failed' with missing deliverables (power_analysis.json, omnidoc_tokenbench.parquet, ground_truth_labels.parquet). This creates a blocking state where downstream tasks (T020, T021) cannot execute, violating the requirement that tasks must be executable and not rely on phantom artifacts.

Task T021 (Data Splitting) explicitly requires 'eval_labels.parquet' derived from T008, but T008 is listed as incomplete with placeholder logic. This creates a hard dependency failure for the entire US1 implementation (T022, T023), violating the requirement that tasks must have valid, existing inputs.

Task T010 (Manual Audit Logic) depends on 'heuristic_labels.csv' from T008b, which is also marked as incomplete with missing artifacts and placeholder code. This prevents the execution of the sanity check pipeline, violating the requirement that tasks must be executable.

Tasks T003b (Git Init), T003c (.gitignore), T004 (requirements.txt), and T005 (Linting) are listed as failed/missing artifacts. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which mandates a pinned requirements.txt and isolated environments before any code execution can be verified.

Task T014 (Cache Directory) is flagged as missing the 'code/data/cache/' directory structure, which is a prerequisite for the chunked processing logic described in T020 (Latent Encoding) to manage memory constraints under the 7GB RAM limit. This violates the requirement that tasks must have valid, existing inputs.

Task T035 (Bonferroni Correction) aggregates p-values from T030 (SSIM) and T031 (Keypoint), but T030 and T031 depend on the editing pipeline (US2) which relies on centroids from US1 (T028). If US1 fails due to T008/T021 issues, T035 will fail to find valid p-values to correct, violating the requirement that tasks must be executable.
